name: Compute Peaks from Spherical Harmonic (SH) data
summary: Extracts fibre orientation peaks from the spherical harmonic FOD at a chosen lmax of a CSD dataset with MRtrix3 sh2peaks, and outputs a peaks image.
description: Selects the FOD image for the requested lmax from the CSD input and runs sh2peaks with optional number of peaks, amplitude threshold and fast mode, writing peaks.nii.gz. Use it when a downstream tool (for example TractSeg or FACT tracking) needs peak directions rather than FODs. Needs a CSD dataset containing the FOD at the requested lmax.

inputs.description: CSD dataset with the response function and FOD images per lmax.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the FOD for the selected lmax.

outputs.description: peaks.nii.gz: 4D image of peak directions (three values per peak, scaled by amplitude).

parameters.description: Spherical harmonic order of the FOD image to extract peaks from.
Number of peaks to extract per voxel (sh2peaks -num).
Minimum FOD amplitude for a peak to be kept (sh2peaks -threshold); 0 means no threshold.
If true, use sh2peaks -fast (precomputed direction set, faster but less precise).

citations.text: Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the CSD input contains the FOD at the requested lmax.
